Le projet exige un traitement exemplaire.La consultation porte sur une mission globale de maîtrise d'oeuvre couvrant à la fois le bâtiment et le process industriel. Le titulaire devra assurer l'intégralité des missions de MOE au sens du Code de la commande publique complétées par des exigences de qualité supérieure pour la gestion des interfaces process/bâtiment, l'accessibilité, la maintenance et la performance thermique de la centrale.

In dem Gebäuderiegel entlang der Kastelburgstraße soll vorab eine Interimsnutzung für Teile der Feuerwehr- und Rettungsdienstschule (FRSM) aus der Aidenbachstraße aufgenommen werden. Die in dem Bauteil im Erdgeschoss vorgesehenen zukünftigen Abstellhallen für Abrollcontainer, Werkstätten und Sozialbereiche sollen für die FRSM als Fahrzeugabstellgassen und Schulungssäle genutzt werden. Die Halle des Paletten-Regallagers für Einsatzmittel kann vorab als Übungshalle der FRSM dienen. Außenflächen werden vorab als Übungsflächen befestigt. Der Aufwand für die Änderungen und Umbauten für die finale Nutzung als Einsatzmittellager ist planerisch schon frühzeitig abzustimmen und zu minimieren. Das genehmigte, vorläufige Nutzerbedarfsprogramm liegt den Anlagen bei. Ebenfalls sind die Anforderungen an Standard und Ausstattung und an Freiflächen dem vorläufigen Nutzerbedarfsprogramm zu entnehmen. Die vorläufigen Flächenbedarfe sowohl für das Einsatzmittellager als auch die Interimsflächen sind in der Anlage Raumprogramm dargestellt. Die Machbarkeitsstudie und Flächenüberlegungen der Branddirektion für die Interimsnutzung liegen als Anlage zum Verfahren bei. Die betriebliche, wirtschaftliche und dabei nachhaltige Umsetzbarkeit eines schlüssigen Gesamtkonzepts, unter Berücksichtigung der Interims- sowie der finalen Nutzung sind wesentliche Anforderungen. Ein Bebauungsplan liegt nicht vor, baurechtliche Beurteilung nach § 30 Abs. BauGB in Verbindung mit § 34 Abs.1 BauGB. Vorbescheid 2023 wurde positiv beschieden. Anforderungen an Freiflächen Für den Außenbereich sind besonders die PKW Stellplätze sowie der Übungshof von besonderer Bedeutung. Eine Tiefgarage sollte nach Möglichkeit vermieden werden. Die im Raumprogramm genannte Anzahl Stellplätze stellt jeweils die Maximalzahl dar. In der Vorplanung ist anhand der umsetzbaren Flächen eine Ermittlung der Stellplätze in Vorabklärung mit der LBK und den baurechtlichen Vorgaben durchzuführen. Der Übungshof dient zur Durchführung von Übungen. Es ist dabei eine versiegelte Manipulationsfläche vorzusehen, um bei Übungen das Eindringen von Ölen und Flüssigkeiten in das Erdreich zu verhindern, die bei Übungen mit Schrott-Pkw austreten können. Dienstwohnungsgebäude müssen einschließlich Freifläche und Spielplatz den Wohnungsbauvorschriften entsprechen.

description: DESCRIPTION: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) AAFC requires a Contractor to conduct field-scale, process-based simulation modelling using measured soil, crop, nutrient, and management datasets from AAFC research fields in Manitoba, and to develop calibrated and evaluated model configurations suitable for assessing, at whole field and management-zone scales, the impacts of alternative cropping systems and climate variability on: • Crop productivity (e.g., yield, biomass) for crops such as wheat, canola, soybean, barley, and/or other crops represented in AAFC datasets; • Soil water dynamics (e.g., soil moisture, plant-available water, water stress indices, drainage/leaching indicators as supported by the modelling framework); • Evapotranspiration (ET) and related water balance components (as supported by the modelling framework and available inputs); • Nutrient cycling and loss indicators, including nitrogen (N) and phosphorus (P) loss pathways (e.g., leaching/runoff/loss indicators as supported by the model framework); and • Long-term soil carbon dynamics (e.g., soil organic carbon trajectories under alternative rotations and management, as supported by the modelling framework and available datasets). This work will include simulation-based evaluation of cash crop systems and exploration of integrating cover crops and/or perennial phases into Prairie rotations, leveraging established cultivar coefficients/parameters where available in the selected model(s) (e.g., DSSAT or equivalent process-based model, including EPIC, APEX/ArcAPEX, DNDC, DayCent, STICS, APSIM, or RZWQM). A parallel agricultural hydrology component will strengthen the representation and evaluation of soil water processes using available AAFC soil moisture, yield, soil physical/chemical properties, and annual fertility datasets. description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires recruitment services to identify and recommend potential highly qualified experts to be retained by the CRA to assist with litigations. These services include identifying candidates that would meet the requirements provided by the Department of Justice, outlining the requirements of the case. The period of the resulting contract will be one (1) year from the date of contract award. This requirement also includes options to extend the contract up to four (4) additional one-year periods under the same conditions. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. The responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will proceed with the conditions precedent to contract award. The Work or a portion of the Work performed under the Contract will be performed on an as-and-when-requested basis and initiated using a Task Authorization (TA). The Work must be completed in accordance with the description of the Work defined in Annex A: Statement of Work and the TA. title: PZA Appenzell Rhodes-Extérieures, remise en état et transformation du bâtiment VIII
description:
Le bâtiment VIII constitue le cœur infrastructurel du PZA et assure des missions essentielles dans les domaines de la restauration, de la logistique, de l’approvisionnement et de l’élimination des déchets, ainsi que de l’offre d’emplois. En tant que plaque tournante logistique du site, il assure la livraison centralisée, la distribution des marchandises et les services techniques indispensables au bon fonctionnement global du PZA. L’augmentation de la capacité d’accueil de 76 à 104 lits en 2025, puis éventuellement à 134 lits, entraîne une hausse des besoins en matière d’approvisionnement et de logistique, que le bâtiment VIII doit prendre en charge. De plus, l’élargissement prévu de l’offre en psychiatrie pour adultes et personnes âgées nécessite un soutien infrastructurel renforcé, notamment dans les domaines de la restauration et de l’offre médicale.


Le bâtiment VIII offre des espaces idéaux pour les services médicaux ambulatoires et les programmes de formation continue et de perfectionnement du PZA. Les espaces existants peuvent être réaménagés et valorisés afin d’accueillir des salles de formation modernes. Le restaurant et la cuisine centrale assurent une fonction d’approvisionnement essentielle pour les patients, le personnel et les visiteurs, tant sur place qu’à distance.


Une procédure de sélection d’un maître d’œuvre selon la méthode sélective est lancée pour la remise en état et la transformation du bâtiment VIII du Centre psychiatrique d’Appenzell Rhodes-Extérieures (PZA) à Herisau. Nous recherchons un cabinet d’architectes qualifié pour la conception et la réalisation, y compris la direction générale des travaux, la coordination des maîtres d’œuvre spécialisés et la gestion de chantier.


La mission comprend la rénovation du bâtiment dans le respect du patrimoine et des normes énergétiques, ainsi que son développement fonctionnel pour accueillir des services de restauration, d’approvisionnement, de formation continue et des prestations médicales. Sont attendus un traitement minutieux du patrimoine bâti historique, une grande qualité architecturale ainsi que des solutions convaincantes sur le plan économique et opérationnel.


Dans le cadre de la préqualification, cinq cabinets d’architectes au maximum seront sélectionnés pour la phase d’appel d’offres qui suivra.

title: France – Software package and information systems – FOURNITURE D’UNE SOLUTION DE FEEDBACK MANAGEMENT (ENQUETES DE SATISFACTION CLIENTS & NPS) ET PRESTATIONS ASSOCIEES
description: . Les directions des branches Services-Courrier-Colis (BSCC) et Grand Public et Numérique (BGPN) de La Poste, représentant six volets fonctionnels, souhaitent renouveler leur solution de Feedback Management et d'Écoute Client. L'objectif est de se doter d’une solution en mode SaaS pour l'administration et la gestion des enquêtes de satisfaction : - création de l'enquête, - programmation, - routage ... - jusque l'exploitation du verbatim, - la restitution des avis et résultats - et en dernier lieu la possibilité de donner une réponse personnalisée au destinataire de l’enquête. . La solution devra permettre la restitution des résultats à tous les maillons de l'organisation (Siège et Territoires), via une connexion SSO, avec des profils et rôles d’utilisateurs différents. . La solution devra permettre la création de dashboard en autonomie selon le type de profil. Les flux de données proviennent de plusieurs SI internes et externes à La Poste, selon les typologies d'enquêtes. . La solution SaaS devra donc s'interfacer avec d'autres outils de La Poste. Les enquêtes couvrent des prestations de services variées au sein de La Poste pour l'ensemble des Directions citées. Chaque Direction a des besoins spécifiques. . La solution devra se conformer au Règlement Général sur la Protection des Données (RGPD). . Le traitement des données personnelles de La Poste, y compris l’hébergement, la sauvegarde et/ou la consultation devra impérativement être localisé au sein de l'Union Européenne (UE), d’un pays de l’Espace Economique Européen (EEE), d’un pays reconnu comme adéquat par l’Union Européenne.. La solution devra également respecter la Politique de Sécurité des SI du Groupe La Poste (PSSIG).

title: USCIS FY27 1st Quarter Engagement with Industry
description: United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), Office of Contracting (OCON), will host its Fiscal Year (FY) 2027 First Quarter Engagement with Industry on October 27, 2026, beginning at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time. These quarterly engagements provide an opportunity for open dialogue between USCIS and industry regarding current and anticipated procurement requirements. The purpose of this event is to share the most current procurement-related information available for USCIS requirements. To participate as an attendee, please self-register using the Microsoft Teams link below: Microsoft Teams meeting https://events.gcc.teams.microsoft.com/event/74f50b56-1413-4370-8199-58b2c86f4a98@5e41ee74-0d2d-4a72-8975-998ce83205eb?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog USCIS uses Microsoft Teams to conduct these industry engagements. Attendees will be muted upon entry, and attendee video will be disabled. Only presenters will be on video. USCIS plans to record this event and post the recording on its YouTube channel after the event. Once available, the recording link will be posted as an update to this SAM.gov announcement. USCIS expects to post draft presentation slides to this announcement on or about October 13, 2026. Format and Questions The event will be organized by execution division and then by the Associate Chief portfolio supporting each program office. Presenters will brief the requirements within each portfolio, including new information and updates, as applicable. Following each portfolio briefing, USCIS will address questions related to that portfolio. Attendees may submit questions through the Microsoft Teams Q&A feature or ask questions verbally when the floor is opened for questions. Please include the requirement title and the applicable slide number and/or Acquisition Planning Forecast System (APFS) number, if available. To help USCIS manage the agenda and stay on schedule, USCIS will address only questions related to the portfolio currently being presented. Once USCIS moves to the next portfolio, it will not return to take additional live questions on a prior portfolio. USCIS strongly encourages industry to submit questions in advance. Advance submission allows USCIS to coordinate with the appropriate program and contracting personnel and provide the most accurate and timely information available during the event. Please submit advance questions to USCIS_Vendoroutreach@uscis.dhs.gov no later than 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 20, 2026. USCIS will collect and review questions received during the event. USCIS will post responses to those questions as an update to this announcement. Information posted to SAM.gov after the event will supersede information provided during the live engagement. Disclaimer The information provided during this event and in the accompanying presentation is for planning purposes only. It does not constitute a pre-solicitation notice, invitation for bids, request for proposals, or request for quotations. The Government is under no obligation to purchase products or services discussed unless and until a formal solicitation or invitation for bids is issued and a contract or order is awarded. All planned procurements are subject to change or cancellation. Requirements currently under an active solicitation or source selection will not be further discussed. Questions regarding those requirements should be directed to the designated Contracting Officer. title: LOC Novel High-Density Optical Data Storage
description: The Library of Congress, hereinafter referred to as the �Library� or �LOC�,� is exploring innovative preservation methods for its digital collections. The LOC is seeking to determine the feasibility of utilizing ultra-high density optical data storage designed for the long-term preservation of a subset of the Library�s digital collections. Currently, the Library manages over 1 billion unique objects of digital preservation data (~33 petabytes) via traditional storage methods. For longevity and reduced migration intervals, it may be reasonable for this portion of data to be permanently stored on a novel medium. The focus would be on a solution that exhibits high areal density, a long lifespan, reduced maintenance/migration cycles, is immutable, and displays a high level of durability. The Library aims to demonstrate the feasibility of an innovative optical data storage solution as a high-density, scalable, and durable medium for storing its preservation collection. The Library wishes to examine the feasibility of this method on a small subset of its digital collections. To be successful, a variety of data formats�including video, audio, text, and images� must be encoded onto the media, errors must be detected/recorded, preservation techniques must be validated and select data must be recalled/read with high fidelity. This work will contribute to the boundary pushing field of high-density optical data storage while pushing the boundaries of access and preservation. The desired outcomes of this requirement are as follows: The successful writing of 1TB of the Library�s digital data in various formats (video, audio, images, text) onto a robust high-density optical media designed to outlast legacy storage solutions at a higher areal density. The determination of the accuracy of the writing process by demonstrating early-stage error detection and ultimate 100% recovery of data. The documentation of successful processes, shortcomings, error rates, timelines, potential solutions to issues, risks, trends, and technological improvements throughout the period of performance as they pertain to the media of choice. Proof of concept for the potential indefinite storage approach of the Library�s data on a novel optical storage medium. The successful recall and reading of all Library-furnished digital files that have been encoded on the media of choice. The isolation of a subset of the data will be carefully curated and stored for the purposes of an educational and artistic display. This will used for educational and display purposes for Library visitors.

description: Request for Proposal (RFP) - 15BRRC26R00000009 Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services and Home Confinement (HC) services for male and female offenders located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes which are located within city limits of Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work (SOW) entitled, �Residential Reentry Center, March, 2022�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, programs, of the SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be a Firm-Fixed Price/IDIQ contract for services with a one-year base period, and four one-year options periods. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 8 beds (8 males and 0 females) and an estimated maximum 20 beds facility in which 18 beds will be designated for males and 2 beds designated for females. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a guaranteed minimum 3 placements and an estimated maximum 8 placements to include both male and female. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. title: Robotic Sheet Metal Forming CAPABILITY REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
description: This is a Capability Request for Information (CRFI) issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) and does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. Responses to this notice are not offers and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with responding to this notice. The United States Air Force Rapid Sustainment Office (RSO) is conducting market research analysis to identify existing solutions for an on-demand, dieless robotic sheet metal forming capability. This capability is intended to produce structural components, brackets, panels, skin sections, and spare parts for support equipment, and aircraft at depot, maintenance, or factory-level facilities. Traditional manufacturing of sheet metal parts relies on heavy, expensive tooling, dies, and presses that require long lead times, high upfront costs, and physical storage. Robotic sheet metal forming�utilizing dual-sided or single-sided synchronized robotic arm manipulators equipped with generic, interchangeable forming styli�offers a flexible, software-defined alternative. The objective of this research is to identify commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or rapidly adaptable solutions capable of being integrated into standard industrial manufacturing and maintenance facilities. This capability is aimed at reducing reliance on traditional supply chains, eliminating the need for part-specific hard tooling, and dramatically accelerating low-volume manufacturing and prototyping cycles. Submitters are encouraged to highlight existing commercial technologies and details on how their hardware and software solutions can be integrated into industrial DoW facilities. Submitters may also identify optional services, such as operator training, technical support, tooling/stylus consumables, and system maintenance. See the attachment with this notice for additional details.

description: Die Stadt Alzey beabsichtigt die Vergabe von Generalplanungsleistungen für die Instandsetzung einer schadensbedingt sanierungsbedürftigen Tiefgarage in der Hospitalstraße 6, 55232 Alzey. Die bestehenden Unterrichts- und OGS-Flächen sind für diesen Bedarf nicht ausreichend. Aus dieser werden die planerischen Schnittstellen zwischen den verschiedenen Disziplinen, Gewerken und Fachbereichen zu entnehmen sein. Bygherre har overvejet, om indkøbet kan opdeles yderligere, men vurderer, at en yderligere opdeling vil indebære en række uhensigtsmæssige tekniske og juridiske grænseflader med deraf følgende risiko for forhindringer i udførelsesfasen samt afledte transaktionsomkostninger.
